decisions.reason: Because this close-to-core line remained prominently presented on its own page across 2023 and 2024, it likely met or exceeded the firm's aspiration level and a small but established firm would keep it unless clearer underperformance appeared.

The serum stayed on the website in both years, suggesting acceptable if less proven performance than Product A, so management would likely retain it while monitoring results against aspirations from similar skincare launches.

As a 2024 launch in the firm's core facial-care range, it is still in the uncertainty period and the firm is likely to use some slack to continue testing it, though the risk of withdrawal is higher because it has a shorter track record and only limited website prominence.
